issues: 没有导出时长，工作台按 150f 默认渲染，44f 静止后又多拖了 30f
浅灰版 + 深墨版叠在平铺 G.bg 灰底上，读作投影/重影而不是印刷，没有一点纸和油墨的质感
标题 "IMPACT" 用回退的 Helvetica，版面只有一根灰色装饰线，空场 20f 很空
8f 撞入是纯平移，没有运动模糊，看不出速度
changes: 补 RISO_MISREGISTRATION_HIT_DURATION = 120（套准后真静止 44f），纸纤维与油墨颗粒都改用静态纹理，尾段逐帧相同
印版换成朱红专色（#e0492f）+ 深墨（#1f1d22）两色，multiply 叠在暖色 riso 再生纸上（径向纸色 + 静态纸纤维 multiply + screen 油墨白点 + 暖褐暗角）；套准即两版归零重合
版面做成双色印刷品：四角套准十字、左上版记 "ISSUE 07 — TWO-COLOUR RISO"、底部 3px 墨线加 "INK · VERMILION / 120 LPI" 说明；标题改为 "Hit print."（系统 SF 栈 230px/900）
撞入段加按速度计算的横向 SpeedBlur；错位包络（A=16/7px、ω=2π/18、τ=60、帧 72 硬切）与 4f 套准脉冲不变
issuesEn: No duration was exported, so the workbench rendered the 150f default and dragged 30f past the 44f hold
A light-grey plate and an ink plate over flat G.bg grey read as a drop shadow or ghosting rather than print, with no feel of paper or ink
The "IMPACT" title fell back to Helvetica, the layout was a single grey rule, and the 20f empty opening felt bare
The 8f slam-in was a plain translation with no motion blur, so speed did not read
changesEn: Added RISO_MISREGISTRATION_HIT_DURATION = 120 (44f truly still after registration); paper fibre and ink grain use static textures so the tail is frame-identical

Plates are now vermilion spot (#e0492f) plus deep ink (#1f1d22), multiplied onto warm riso stock (radial paper tone, static fibre via multiply, screen-blended ink speckle, warm-brown vignette); registration means both plates snap to zero and coincide

The layout is now a two-colour print: registration crosshairs in all four corners, an "ISSUE 07 — TWO-COLOUR RISO" folio top-left, and a 3px ink rule with an "INK · VERMILION / 120 LPI" caption; the title is now "Hit print." (system SF stack, 230px/900)
The slam-in gets velocity-driven horizontal SpeedBlur; the misregistration envelope (A = 16/7px, ω = 2π/18, τ = 60, hard snap at f72) and the 4f registration pulse are unchanged
